literal_meaning: অন্ন (food or rice) উঠা (rising or being removed)
figurative_meaning_en: The end of one's lifespan or ultimate life
example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃদ্ধের অন্ন উঠেছে, এবার যাবার পালা।
example_sentences_in_english: The old man's food has risen; it's his time to go.
note: Refers to the traditional practice of removing food from an elderly person's plate as a metaphor for the end of life in rural Bengali households.
